title: Super Pixel Merge Balls
description:
DROP. MERGE. GROW. REPEAT.Super Pixel Merge Balls is a simple and satisfying physics puzzle about dropping colorful pixel balls, merging matching ones, and discovering what comes next.

Start small. Every pair of matching balls creates something bigger — and before long, your peaceful little container becomes a chaotic pile of pixel personalities.

SIMPLE TO PLAY, HARD TO PUT DOWN

There are no timers and no complicated mechanics to learn. Choose where to drop, let physics do its thing, and plan your next move as the container gets fuller and fuller.

Play at your own pace and enjoy the merges, or keep pushing to beat your personal best.

FEATURES

• Simple drop-and-merge physics gameplay
• A cast of colorful pixel-art balls to discover
• Easy controls you can learn in seconds
• Endless high-score chasing
• No timers — play at your own pace
• Perfect for quick sessions or longer runs
• A great companion for music, podcasts, or just relaxing

Every merge gets you closer to the next surprise.

Just one more merge.
description_short: Drop, merge, and grow! Combine matching pixel balls to create bigger and bigger ones in a simple, satisfying physics puzzle. Relax, discover them all, and chase your next high score.
